name: Kajiwara Shinobu
source:
The protagonist's homeroom teacher, his subject is art.
A prideful guy who believes in his own supremacy, a realist who doesn't believe in fortune telling.
He loves fun and interesting things.
He's popular with the students because of his good looks.
